points.description: First valid limitation of AJM (abrasive jet machining), e.g. low material removal rate, limited nozzle life/nozzle wear, high cost, or an equivalent correct limitation (e.g. abrasive embedding, poor accuracy/taper, cannot machine soft materials).
Second, different valid limitation of AJM from the same kind of list. Equivalent wording accepted; must be distinct from the first.
